title: claude mcp add treats the MCP server's own flags as Claude Code options
symptoms: The server is not added, so claude mcp get reports no server by that name
cause: Without a double dash, Claude Code parses everything on the line as its own options, so server flags are consumed or rejected. Everything after -- is passed to the server untouched.
fix: Put Claude Code options such as --transport, --env, and --scope before the server name, then -- and the server command with its own flags.
apply: claude mcp add --transport stdio --env KEY=value --scope project myserver -- python server.py --port 8080
affected: Claude Code claude mcp add, as of 2026-10
